messages:
Ravi N: quick idea — add a tiny confidence band and an "attribution mode" hint to the mini cost card in the rollout rail. primary goal: stop product folks from treating the number as precise.
Marta B: strongly +1. UX: show "Est: 8.6k ±18% (v3)" and a cheeky small dropdown: Attribution: [first-touch | proportional | pool]. default = first-touch but explain tradeoffs.
Jules F: backend reality check: supporting 'proportional' precisely needs join against cache_key traces & recent hit-shares — that's a Big Query-style op. we can do approx: emit per-route unique_cache_key_count and per-route kv_hit_count in the rollup; proportional = kv_hits * (1 / unique_keys) * avg_cached_tokens as a heuristic. cheap & deterministic.
Ravi N: that heuristic might under/over estimate for routes that share keys heavily with other routes. can we tag the route with shared_key_score if our sampler sees same key across >N routes in the window? then UI shows a yellow badge "shared keys likely".
Jules F: yes. add metric tag `shared_prefetch_score` (0..1). compute by sampling last 10k kv_hit events per route and counting how often cache_key is observed elsewhere. cheapish if we sample at emit-time.
Marta B: great — UI copy suggestion: "Estimated tokens (calc v3). This is an approximation using sampled kv_hits and model histograms. Toggle attribution to see alternate allocations. See docs for billing guidance." small link to `/docs/costs/attribution`.
Ravi N: rollout: feature-flag, run in staging for a week, dark-launch to 5% org, collect two signals: median_est_error (vs nightly recon) and shared_prefetch_warning_rate. Goal: median_est_error < 20% before enabling org-wide.
Jules F: monitoring: emit `cost_estimation.v3.median_error` and `cost_estimation.v3.shared_warning_count`. If median_error > 30% for 6h trigger auto-increase of sampling for affected routes.
Marta B: runbook snippet for SRE: If card spikes but billing flat -> 1) open route-level recon `/api/internal/cost/recon?route_id=...` 2) check `shared_prefetch_score` 3) inspect routing sticky flags and recent warmup events 4) if shared_prefetch_score > 0.4, run per-key attribution tool (`/ops/tools/key-attrib --route ...`).
Jules F: implementation plan: (1) rollup job emits `gross_tokens`, `kv_hit_count`, `unique_cache_keys_est`, `shared_prefetch_score`, `calc_version` and `sample_rate` (2) store small provenance blob in metric tag (stringified) (3) front-end renders main num + `±X%` from bootstrap CI computed in rollup.
Ravi N: UX ask: make the attribution dropdown non-destructive (client-only) — selected mode should not change backend metrics, only presentation. that avoids versioning headaches.
Marta B: agree. also add a tiny "explain" panel that shows the math in one line: "est = kv_hits * avg_cached_tokens (model hist v12) * attribution_factor(mode)". keep it terse.
Jules F: one more edge: realtime routes with very low volume will have huge CI. UI should collapse to "insufficient data" if sample_count < 50 in the window.
Ravi N: good. I'll write the small tooltip + panel copy and add the doc link. Jules, can you take the backend ticket for rollup v3?
Jules F: on it. I'll tag the PR with feature-flag `mini_cost_v3` and emit the provenance fields.
ops-bot: canary deploy scheduled for branch "eng/mini-cost-confidence" to staging at 2024-09-25T20:00:00Z :rocket:
Marta B: thanks — leaving thread open for PR links and copy reviews.
